name: Bookings
description: Appointment booking system: services with weekly availability, a public slot picker with race-safe reservations, email confirmations, and an admin agenda. WordPress parity: Amelia / Bookly (v1 scope).
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Read services, availability, and bookings to build the agenda and the public slot picker (own prefixed tables only).
Create/update services and record reservations with a race-safe insert (own prefixed tables only).
Read the plugin configuration (notification email, minimum notice hours).
Store the plugin configuration (notification email, minimum notice hours).
Register the public booking endpoints and the admin agenda/services API under /api/v1/plugin/bookings/*.
Add the Reservas entry to the admin sidebar.
Send the booking confirmation to the customer and notify the site owner of new reservations.
